title: Runtime type generation & JSON Schema helpers for streamable discriminated outputs
creator: Asha Patel
comments: 2025-01-09 - Asha Patel: Initial triage and scope definition. Punted on full AJV streaming approach; prefer Zod + light predicates for web ergonomics.

2025-01-15 - Miguel Ortega: Spike completed for discriminator hint extraction. Implemented tag-first heuristic that reads the first 256 bytes and looks for tag tokens. Patch in branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ts/pull/1245
2025-01-20 - Priya Singh (Design): Reviewed API sketch; suggested returning structured enums instead of strings for `prefixValidator` to make TypeScript narrowing easier. Marked as nice-to-have.

2025-01-26 - QA (Jordan Blake): Added streaming fixture set (10k sample sequences) and observed 92% early-tag detection on first 256B. Need heuristic tweaks to reach 95% target. Filed follow-up: ENG-980010.

2025-02-05 - Miguel Ortega: Implemented `light` predicate mode and added tree-shake notes in README. Benchmarks: `light` validators are ~4x faster and add ~6KB gzipped to bundle vs ~42KB for full Zod schema.

2025-02-12 - Security Review Request: Submitted PR for review; security flagged no immediate risks but requested a doc for how validators treat unknown additional properties (we default to allow and emit telemetry).

2025-02-14 - Asha Patel: Documentation draft merged to `docs/sdk/typegen-runtime-validators.md`. Planning to cut `typescript-sdk-2025.02` release with opt-in flag. Next: address QA heuristic improvements and add example migration notebook.
examples:
Example: generated Order schema exports:
- generated/runtime/order.d.ts -> exported Order type (discriminated union)
- generated/runtime/order.zod.ts -> z.object/z.union schemas
- generated/runtime/order.jsonschema.json -> JSON Schema for policy engine
- generated/runtime/order.runtime.ts -> prefixValidator / finalizeValidator / light predicates

Migration note:
- Old flow: JSON.parse -> unsafe cast to Order
- New flow: import generated runtime validators, check prefix in streaming path, finalize at end for guaranteed runtime-safety
